name: Employee Asset Allocation
query:
SELECT 
    e.name as "Employee:Link/Employee:150",
    e.employee_name as "Employee Name:Data:180",
    ca.name as "Asset:Link/Company Asset:150",
    ca.asset_name as "Asset Name:Data:180",
    ca.status as "Status:Data:100",
    ea.issue_date as "Issue Date:Date:120",
    ea.return_date as "Return Date:Date:120"
FROM `tabEmployee Asset Allocation` ea
LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` e ON ea.parent = e.name
LEFT JOIN `tabCompany Asset` ca ON ea.asset = ca.name
ORDER BY e.name;
